audience: HR and operations teams that look up people, groups and out-of-office status in Pingboard

useCases.title: Find who reports to a person and their groups
useCases.text: List users with their job titles and reports-to ids. Read one user with the groups that user belongs to.

useCases.title: Search the directory by job title or skill
useCases.text: Search users by a text query, such as a job title, skill or interest.

useCases.title: List the members of a team or department
useCases.text: Search or list groups with their member counts. Read one group to see its member user ids.

useCases.title: Check who is out of office this week
useCases.text: List status entries, such as out-of-office periods, and read one entry. Check the status types the company can use.

useCases.title: Review the custom profile fields
useCases.text: List the company's custom profile fields with their type and visibility. Read the company name and terminology.
